destination.title: String limits, light spectra and control of gravitational effective theories
destination.question: How do compactification parameters and quantum effects determine light objects, interaction strengths, effective dimensions and the validity of gravitational descriptions?
destination.summary: A navigational family with an emergent-string and infinite-distance core, connected to spectral tests, quantum boundaries, dimensional reduction and controlled model building. Membership does not imply a shared mechanism, conjecture or canonical question.

systems: String compactifications and gravitational EFTs in the dimensions specified by each source
Geometric, potentially non-geometric and holographic descriptions
targets: Asymptotic strings, particle towers and decompactification
Interaction strengths, cutoff hierarchies and controlled phenomenology
regimes: Infinite-distance limits and their possible quantum obstructions
Finite-distance boundaries, finite-radius compactifications and stabilized vacua where explicitly relevant
assumptions: Conjectures remain hypotheses or conditional organizing principles
Source-specific control conditions and dimensions are not shared automatically
conventions: Keep gravitational, string, KK, tension and species scales distinct
Preserve source-specific normalizations and coupling dictionaries
includes: Methods and applications with explicit connections to the overview questions
excludes: A universal proof of the Emergent String Conjecture
Automatic equivalence of sources sharing terminology
Automatic inclusion of every string consistency problem in the infinite-distance core

sources.title: Anisotropic Modulus Stabilisation: Strings at LHC Scales with Micron-sized Extra Dimensions

evidence.text: Can Type IIB modulus stabilisation generate TeV-scale strings with two micron-sized dimensions and four much smaller dimensions, while determining the associated light spectrum and phenomenological constraints?

sources.title: Local String Models and Moduli Stabilisation

evidence.text: How far have local string particle-physics models progressed toward globally consistent compactifications with stabilized moduli, supersymmetry breaking, realistic scales and viable cosmology?

sources.title: TASI Lectures on Remnants from the String Landscape

evidence.text: Can internal geometry lower the fundamental scale enough to make string-related excitations accessible?

sources.title: Instantons and infinite distances

evidence.text: Which stable strings and excitations remain light after quantum corrections, and can their effects explain the proposed endpoint or the divergent local kinetic scales?

sources.title: Instanton Corrections and Emergent Strings

evidence.text: Do infinite-distance limits with dominant instanton corrections realize the Emergent String Conjecture? The paper tests whether quantum-corrected trajectories yield a unique lightest, asymptotically tensionless weakly coupled string, or instead a decompactification limit.

sources.title: On TCS G$_{2}$ manifolds and 4D emergent strings

evidence.text: How do G4 flux, string indices, candidate G2 enumerative quantities, and stability of light states interact in a TCS emergent-string limit?

sources.title: On TCS G$_{2}$ manifolds and 4D emergent strings

evidence.text: Can an infinite-distance limit of a four-dimensional theory with four supercharges admit a weakly coupled fundamental-string description, and does quantum physics preserve the classical shrinking-fiber trajectory?

sources.title: UV Shadows in EFTs: Accidental Symmetries, Robustness and No‐Scale Supergravity

evidence.text: Why do perturbative string compactifications so often yield no-scale supergravity, and which quantum or α′ corrections first lift its flat potentials? The authors seek symmetry-based constraints that assess the robustness of moduli stabilization and explain classical de Sitter obstructions.

sources.title: Swampland Conjectures for Strings and Membranes

evidence.text: How can charge, tension and a Weak Gravity Conjecture be defined for four-dimensional strings and membranes when their backreaction prevents an asymptotically free-state description?

sources.title: Quantum corrections in 4d $N$ = 1 infinite distance limits and the weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: Do quantum corrections preserve the emergent-string classification of infinite-distance limits in 4d N=1 F-theory, and how must gauge thresholds and string-excitation masses enter the WGC away from strict weak coupling?

sources.title: Lectures on the Swampland Program in String Compactifications

evidence.text: Can precise calculations in controlled string-theory corners sharpen conjectures and determine ambiguous coefficients? The source proposes boundary regimes with weakly coupled Einstein gravity as a testing ground and identifies nonsupersymmetric extensions as a major obstacle.

sources.title: Lectures on the Swampland Program in String Compactifications

evidence.text: Can EFT data determine tower rates and leading objects, and can the conjecture constrain potentials, spacetime profiles and cosmology without relying solely on string examples?

sources.title: Infinite Distance Limits and Information Theory

evidence.text: Can information geometry identify weakly coupled boundary descriptions or classify infinite-distance limits beyond known supersymmetric examples?

sources.title: 4d strings at strong coupling

evidence.text: Can local, weakly coupled EFT-string solutions extend through strong coupling to finite-energy global BPS configurations, and can these extensions bound string tensions away from weak coupling?

sources.title: E$_{9}$ symmetry in the heterotic string on S$^{1}$ and the weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: Which affine gauge algebras arise from asymptotically massless heterotic-string towers at the infinite-distance limits of circle moduli space, and how do their vector states realize the lattice weak gravity and repulsive force conditions?

sources.title: The asymptotic Weak Gravity Conjecture for open strings

evidence.text: Can excitations of asymptotically weakly coupled axionic/EFT strings furnish the tower WGC for four-dimensional open-string gauge sectors when no critical heterotic string emerges? Which scale hierarchies determine whether this is a controlled four-dimensional question?

sources.title: The emergence proposal in quantum gravity and the species scale

evidence.text: Can species-cutoff quantum corrections generate light-field kinetic terms and flux potentials in string vacua, explaining their asymptotic singularities and connections to Swampland conjectures?

sources.title: The Standard Model from String Theory: What Have We Learned?

evidence.text: How closely can string compactifications reproduce observed particle physics, which spectra and interactions can quantum-gravity consistency exclude, and which features are typical? The review also asks what string constructions teach about hierarchies and naturalness.

sources.title: A twist at infinite distance in the CHL string

evidence.text: Which space-time BPS algebra emerges when the nine-dimensional CHL string approaches its infinite-distance decompactification limit, and how is its twisting realized in the large-radius and T-dual small-radius descriptions?

sources.title: A symmetry-centric perspective on the geometry of the string landscape and the swampland

evidence.text: Can the Ooguri–Vafa conjectures about quantum-gravity scalar moduli spaces be understood through gauging or breaking generalized global symmetries, giving motivation beyond supersymmetric string examples?

sources.title: On the K-point in moduli space

evidence.text: Can K-point supergravity data be interpreted as thresholds from integrating out a light BPS state, analogously to the conifold, and what would this imply for emergent infinite distance and the Distance Conjecture?

sources.title: <math display="inline"><mi>K</mi></math> points and type IIB/heterotic duality with NS5-branes

evidence.text: What produces the leading non-perturbative prepotential near type II_0 degenerations and one-modulus K-points, and can these terms coexist with the weakly coupled gravitational string sector required by the Distance and Emergent String Conjectures?

sources.title: Towards the non-perturbative completion of 4d 𝒩 = 1 effective theories of gravity

evidence.text: Does consistency of string-derived 4d N=1 gravity require additional light states of non-perturbative origin, beyond corrections to EFT couplings, and how do these states enlarge the perturbatively accessible moduli space?

sources.title: On Type II$_0$ Loci in Moduli Space

evidence.text: Can type II₀ infinite-distance singularities arise from infrared thresholds below the fundamental string scale, and what do their complex-charge threshold forms reveal about the light nonperturbative sector?

sources.title: Towards the realization of the dark dimension scenario in Hořava-Witten theory

evidence.text: Can Hořava–Witten theory realize a single large dark dimension while retaining realistic gauge couplings, avoiding rapid proton decay and controlling quantum corrections?

sources.title: EFTs with Symmetric Moduli Spaces: the Landscape and the Swampland

evidence.text: Which locally symmetric moduli spaces, particle representations and metric normalizations reproduce the Emergent String Conjecture (ESC) rates, and how are the resulting EFTs related by embeddings and decompactification?

sources.title: EFT (String) Tower Building

evidence.text: Can asymptotic Kähler potentials determine the allowed light-tower spectra and duality arrangements of 4d N=1 EFTs, and can the Integral Scaling Relation plus the Emergent String Conjecture exclude otherwise plausible potentials?

sources.title: Little string theory at a TeV

evidence.text: Can little string physics and all compactification scales lie near a TeV, with weak gravity explained by a tiny string coupling while ordinary gauge interactions remain appreciable? Can this connect the hierarchy problem to dilaton runaway?

sources.title: Anisotropic Modulus Stabilisation: Strings at LHC Scales with Micron-sized Extra Dimensions

evidence.text: Canonically normalise moduli, diagonalise their kinetic and mass matrices, track volume powers in gauge couplings, and estimate radiative mass shifts using Coleman-Weinberg arguments with attention to higher-dimensional thresholds.

sources.title: Local String Models and Moduli Stabilisation

evidence.text: The review organizes stabilization through N=1 supergravity F- and D-term potentials, combining flux superpotentials, nonperturbative W corrections and perturbative/nonperturbative K corrections in a large-volume expansion.

sources.title: TASI Lectures on Remnants from the String Landscape

evidence.text: Solve section-degree constraints without denominator coordinates, extract minimal divisor factors, and identify the candidate fiber. Check monodromy and matter separately before concluding non-Higgsability.

sources.title: Instantons and infinite distances

evidence.text: Resum wrapping contributions before estimating the populated charge lattice. Separate action-dominance regions, apply the invariant model, and combine their exponents with the contact-potential denominator.

sources.title: Instanton Corrections and Emergent Strings

evidence.text: For type I, an imported loop- and D1-instanton-corrected Kähler potential is used to estimate axion decay constants and associated BPS string tensions; heterotic duality identifies the competing winding tower.

sources.title: On TCS G$_{2}$ manifolds and 4D emergent strings

evidence.text: Compactify the string, map the state through F/M/IIA duality, and evaluate the wrapped heterotic formula. The paper substitutes this probe for a fourfold mirror-period calculation.

sources.title: Nonperturbative resolution of strong coupling singularities in 4D <math display="inline"><mi mathvariant="script">N</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></math> heterotic M-theory

evidence.text: Do nonperturbative corrections resolve the finite-distance strong-coupling boundary inferred for the hidden heterotic E8 gauge group, allowing the four-dimensional N=1 scalar field space to continue beyond it?

sources.title: Gopakumar-Vafa invariants and the Emergent String Conjecture

evidence.text: Do gauge-coupling asymptotics and charged BPS indices distinguish decompactification from emergent-string limits in five-dimensional supergravity, and do Calabi-Yau data satisfy the resulting geometric predictions of the Emergent String Conjecture?

sources.title: The Weak Gravity Conjecture and Scalar Fields

evidence.text: When do multiple brane wrappings produce an infinite particle tower rather than repeated descriptions or finitely many relevant states?

sources.title: Emergent strings, duality and weak coupling limits for two-form fields

evidence.text: Does weak coupling of a two-form field with finite gravitational strength force an emergent fundamental string, and how does this differ from weak coupling of a one-form field?

sources.title: de Sitter Extrema and the Swampland

evidence.text: When can a non-geometric supergravity solution be trusted despite string-sized cycles in a naive geometric description?

sources.title: Emergent strings from infinite distance limits

evidence.text: Does emergent-string behavior survive quantum effects in hypermultiplet infinite-distance limits?

sources.title: A Note on String Excitations and the Higuchi Bound

evidence.text: Does the tower of increasingly high-spin perturbative string excitations conflict with the de Sitter Higuchi bound, and what additional string-scale constraint follows if flat-space Regge behavior is required to persist to a specified ultraviolet cutoff?

sources.title: Higher-order corrections to mass-charge relation of extremal black holes

evidence.text: Do heterotic-string higher-derivative couplings satisfy the mass-lowering condition when a Reissner-Nordström background is available? The example makes this background conditional on a heavy stabilized dilaton and on preservation of the imported couplings.

sources.title: EFT strings and emergence

evidence.text: Can one-loop thresholds from the complete light spectrum below the species scale reproduce asymptotic gauge kinetic functions in type IIA infinite-distance limits, resolving the w = 2 mismatch and incorporating EFT string oscillations in w = 1 limits?

sources.title: Membrane limits in quantum gravity

evidence.text: Does consistency of the Emergent String Conjecture under dimensional reduction forbid infinite-distance limits where a membrane becomes light at the KK scale, and how is this obstruction realized in Calabi–Yau compactifications?

sources.title: Fermions and the Swampland

evidence.text: Do charged open-string scalar modes satisfy the coupling bound independently of their expectation values? Expected nonperturbative towers and geometric uplifts have not been converted into quantitative tests.

sources.title: Emergent strings, duality and weak coupling limits for two-form fields

evidence.text: Does the light Kaluza-Klein tower indicate that the weak-coupling limit simply opens an extra dimension? The authors compare its limiting rate with that of string excitations.

sources.title: Testing Swampland Conjectures with Machine Learning

evidence.text: Which generated critical points admit the perturbative effective description? The authors associate very small string coupling with that description and identify Re S ≪ 1 as a non-perturbative region in which the largest potential values cannot be trusted.

sources.title: Large Field Distances from EFT strings

evidence.text: Can fundamental axionic strings characterize infinite-distance limits of four-dimensional quantum-gravity EFTs and connect the string Weak Gravity Conjecture to the Distance Conjecture using EFT data?

sources.title: Taxonomy of branes in infinite distance limits

evidence.text: What restrictions does the Emergent String Conjecture impose on the moduli dependence and required population of particle towers and branes, particularly when the conjecture must survive dimensional reduction?

sources.title: Quantum obstructions for $N=1$ infinite distance limits -- Part I: $g_s$ obstructions

evidence.text: Do classical infinite-distance complex-structure limits of Type IIB O7/O3 orientifolds remain accessible with perturbative control after pure string-coupling corrections, and what geometric information determines their obstruction?

sources.title: Emergent strings in Type IIB Calabi-Yau compactifications

evidence.text: Do type II infinite-distance limits of Type IIB complex-structure moduli space realize a unique critical emergent string with an accompanying particle tower, despite lacking wrapped branes that directly produce the required BPS string?

sources.title: Analysis And Spectral Theory Of Neck-Stretching Problems: Analysis and Spectral Theory...: T. Langlais

evidence.text: How can elliptic inverses be controlled as a cylindrical neck stretches, especially when the model operator has real roots, and what determines the resulting low Laplacian spectrum and light Kaluza–Klein towers?

sources.title: Reconstructing string dualities through symmetries of moduli spaces

evidence.text: How far can moduli-space symmetries and the Emergent String Conjecture reconstruct the dual perturbative descriptions at infinite distance, including strong-coupling limits, from a known weakly coupled description?

sources.title: Fundamental Physics, the Swampland of Effective Field Theory and Early Universe Cosmology

evidence.text: How do the additional string sectors change the response to shrinking a compact spatial radius?

sources.title: Emergent strings from infinite distance limits

evidence.text: Which classical emergent-string trajectories survive quantum geometry, and can dilaton co-scaling prevent KK dominance in four-dimensional Type IIA?

sources.title: Tensionless Strings and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can the nearly tensionless BPS string satisfy a string version of weak gravity relative to charged black-string solutions? The paper identifies relevant tensor and Green–Schwarz charge structures but leaves their quantitative comparison open.

sources.title: Emergent Strings at an Infinite Distance with Broken Supersymmetry

evidence.text: Do the endpoints of an unstable flux-vacuum cascade with broken supersymmetry lie at generalized infinite distance, and do KK or emergent-string towers become exponentially light there?

sources.title: On Towers of Light States at Infinite Distance

evidence.text: What microscopic towers become light at infinite distance in the studied F-theory moduli spaces, and does their geometric classification support the Emergent String Conjecture's alternatives of weakly coupled critical strings or spacetime decompactification?

sources.title: A Spin‐2 Conjecture on the Swampland

evidence.text: The D3 example tests whether an explicit string realization of a massive spin-2 mode has the tower and coupling scale expected from the conjecture.

sources.title: Emergent M-theory limit

evidence.text: What perturbative quantum-gravity description should emerge at infinite type II string coupling when complete towers are selected by their typical mass scale relative to the species scale? In particular, which degrees of freedom are required for a putative M-theory formulation on a large circle?

sources.title: The Swampland Distance Conjecture and Towers of Tensionless Branes

evidence.text: How does restoring the parent N=2 spectrum alter possible particle and string towers?

sources.title: Tensionless string limits in 4d conformal manifolds

evidence.text: How are overall-free infinite-distance limits of large-N 4d SCFTs classified by higher-spin decay rates and densities of states, what tensionless strings might describe them, and what do their towers imply for AdS scale separation?

sources.title: The EFT stringy viewpoint on large distances

evidence.text: Can fundamental axionic strings characterize every infinite-distance limit of a gravitational 4d EFT and constrain its maximal cutoff and leading light tower using EFT data?

sources.title: The EFT stringy viewpoint on large distances

evidence.text: The toroidal G_2 example tests how the pattern of growing period saxions determines the lightest KK tower relative to the wrapped-M5 string tension. Different fixed charge supports provide distinct asymptotic limits within one explicit geometric dictionary.

sources.title: Tensionless Strings and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Why can a non-critical string become tensionless at finite distance while a transverse gauge coupling remains finite? The authors question whether its non-BPS particle excitations actually form an infinite massless tower.

sources.title: Integral Scaling for EFT Strings from the Bottom-Up

evidence.text: Can brane-taxonomy rules rooted in the Emergent String Conjecture explain why the leading tower along a 4D EFT-string flow obeys (mtow/MPl)^2∼(T/MPl^2)^w with w∈{1,2,3}, and clarify extensions to subleading towers and bound states?

sources.title: Moduli-Space Laplacians, Asymptotic Geometry, and the Emergent String Conjecture

evidence.text: Does the Emergent String Conjecture constrain asymptotic moduli-space geometry through quantized Laplacians of light tower masses, and how are these constraints related to shrinking axion fibers and instantons?

sources.title: Emergent strings from infinite distance limits

evidence.text: When does five-to-six-dimensional decompactification also approach a weakly coupled string limit in six dimensions?

sources.title: Fermions and the Swampland

evidence.text: Does the sectoral bound extend to every bosonic tower? Decompactification could separate the graviphoton scale from parent-theory breaking, but independent radius variation has not been established in a complete string construction.

sources.title: Asymptotics of 5d supergravity theories and the emergent string conjecture

evidence.text: Can consistency of supergravity string probes classify infinite-distance limits of five-dimensional theories with eight supercharges, including uniqueness of the leading weakly coupled fields, and provide evidence for the Emergent String Conjecture without assuming a compactification origin?

sources.title: Nondecoupling of Maximal Supergravity from the Superstring

evidence.text: How must compactification radius, string length, and string coupling vary when lower-dimensional gravitational strength is held fixed?

sources.title: Duality and dilaton

evidence.text: How must the dilaton and other background couplings transform under radius inversion when the radius depends on spectator coordinates, and what survives beyond one-loop sigma-model perturbation theory?

sources.title: Ray–Singer torsion, topological strings, and black holes

evidence.text: How does holomorphic Ray–Singer torsion, through genus-one topological strings and mirror symmetry, measure light degrees of freedom and a moduli-dependent gravitational species cutoff? The review also explains the resulting restrictions on slowly varying positive potentials.

sources.title: Emergent strings from infinite distance limits

evidence.text: Can a shrinking elliptic fiber compensate a growing base and keep quantum volume finite? The classical cubic supplies the starting comparison, but continuation changes its small-fiber interpretation.

sources.title: Moduli-dependent Calabi-Yau and SU(3)-structure metrics from Machine Learning

evidence.text: Can learned internal metrics enable normalized particle spectra, their moduli dependence, bundle connections, special-cycle calculations, and fibration diagnostics? These questions motivate potential applications to string phenomenology, the distance conjecture, and stabilization.

sources.title: Light strings and strong coupling in F-theory

evidence.text: What non-perturbative physics ends the weakly coupled light-string regime of 4d N=1 F-theory, and explains obstructions to certain classically allowed emergent-string limits?

sources.title: Emergent strings from infinite distance limits

evidence.text: Must a gravitational infinite-distance limit that preserves the effective dimension produce a weakly coupled tensionless string?

sources.title: Species scale, worldsheet CFTs and emergent geometry

evidence.text: Do potentially non-geometric perturbative string vacua exhibit the decompactification/emergent-string behavior expected at infinite distance? Specifically, does a graviton-amplitude cutoff proxy detect light towers and scale with the internal CFT gap as in geometric limits?

sources.title: EFT strings and dualities in 4d 𝒩 = 1

evidence.text: How do light towers, EFT strings and species scales organize perturbative infinite-distance limits of 4d N=1 compactifications, and does integer tension–mass scaling extend to subleading towers and non-elementary string flows?

sources.title: Tensionless Strings and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: How do geometric volumes control gravitational and gauge interactions in a six-dimensional compactification? The setting keeps the gravitational scale fixed while varying the shape of the compact base.

sources.title: Instantons and infinite distances

evidence.text: Do instanton corrections preserve a classically infinite field-space distance, or can the endpoint move to finite distance while string scales and effective-theory control deteriorate?

sources.title: Emergent strings from infinite distance limits

evidence.text: Must an equi-dimensional infinite-distance limit of quantum gravity approach a unique weakly coupled string theory, and how is this realized or obstructed in Calabi–Yau three-fold compactifications?

sources.title: String Landscape and the Standard Model of Particle Physics

evidence.text: String model building must connect moduli-dependent parameters to particle physics and cosmology. Flat moduli prevent definite coupling predictions, while their stabilization must remain within the regime of the effective description.

sources.title: Emergent strings, duality and weak coupling limits for two-form fields

evidence.text: What strings or higher-dimensional descriptions emerge in Class B weak-coupling limits? The source identifies this as an unresolved extension of its Class A analysis.

sources.title: Wilsonian Effective Field Theory and String Theory

evidence.text: Which physical scale bounds a four-dimensional EFT obtained by compactifying string theory? The internal volume separates the KK threshold from the higher string scale, so the four-dimensional matching problem begins at the effective KK scale.

sources.title: String Gases and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can a gas of strings stabilize compactification moduli while respecting the proposed constraints on scalar potentials and the relative strength of gauge and gravitational interactions?

sources.title: Quantum obstructions for $N=1$ infinite distance limits -- Part II: Kähler obstructions

evidence.text: Can classical infinite-distance complex-structure limits of 4d N=1 F-theory remain perturbatively controlled at finite Einstein-frame divisor volumes, once complex-structure-dependent corrections to the Kähler sector are included?

sources.title: Determining the dual

evidence.text: For either heterotic string compactified on a circle, what happens as R→0 at fixed arbitrary Wilson line? How are the two heterotic descriptions related at general moduli, and what minimum radius remains when the larger-radius description is chosen?

sources.title: Dimensional reduction and (Anti) de Sitter bounds

evidence.text: Which asymptotic regions and vacuum families satisfy the selected bounds, and can higher-dimensional string compactifications test their cosmological implications?

sources.title: The Swampland: Introduction and Review

evidence.text: How does a compact dimension's size become a lower-dimensional field? The circumference L=2πR is exponential in the radion φ, relating radius limits to excursions in scalar field space.

sources.title: Emergent strings from infinite distance limits

evidence.text: Which infinite-distance limits of Calabi–Yau compactifications produce an emergent string, and which decompactify? The answer requires specifying whether masses are measured relative to the string, field-theory, or gravitational scale.

sources.title: Laplacian spectrum on a nilmanifold, truncations and effective theories

evidence.text: How do base sizes, fiber size, and quantized twist control spectra on a curved compact space? Since f=Nr^3/(r^1r^2), varying the fiber radius at fixed topology also varies the curvature scale.

Can the Ooguri–Vafa conjectures about quantum-gravity scalar moduli spaces be understood through gauging or breaking generalized global symmetries, giving motivation beyond supersymmetric string examples?

Can K-point supergravity data be interpreted as thresholds from integrating out a light BPS state, analogously to the conifold, and what would this imply for emergent infinite distance and the Distance Conjecture?

What produces the leading non-perturbative prepotential near type II_0 degenerations and one-modulus K-points, and can these terms coexist with the weakly coupled gravitational string sector required by the Distance and Emergent String Conjectures?

Does consistency of string-derived 4d N=1 gravity require additional light states of non-perturbative origin, beyond corrections to EFT couplings, and how do these states enlarge the perturbatively accessible moduli space?

Can type II₀ infinite-distance singularities arise from infrared thresholds below the fundamental string scale, and what do their complex-charge threshold forms reveal about the light nonperturbative sector?
Can Hořava–Witten theory realize a single large dark dimension while retaining realistic gauge couplings, avoiding rapid proton decay and controlling quantum corrections?

Which locally symmetric moduli spaces, particle representations and metric normalizations reproduce the Emergent String Conjecture (ESC) rates, and how are the resulting EFTs related by embeddings and decompactification?

Can asymptotic Kähler potentials determine the allowed light-tower spectra and duality arrangements of 4d N=1 EFTs, and can the Integral Scaling Relation plus the Emergent String Conjecture exclude otherwise plausible potentials?

Can little string physics and all compactification scales lie near a TeV, with weak gravity explained by a tiny string coupling while ordinary gauge interactions remain appreciable? Can this connect the hierarchy problem to dilaton runaway?

destination.title: Inflationary dynamics and cosmological perturbations
destination.question: How do different inflationary fields, gravitational frameworks and initial conditions affect background evolution, primordial perturbations and source-specific consistency tests?
destination.summary: The original numerical membership is useful for discovery but does not establish a single physical mechanism, a shared Swampland premise or equivalent questions. No separate original scientific scope statement was supplied. Background-only facets remain useful, while complexity and localized-source dynamics receive explicit neighboring homes.

systems: Scalar, vector, gauge and antisymmetric-tensor inflationary systems
Curved scalar target spaces and noncanonical scalar dynamics
Modified gravity and source-specific higher-dimensional constructions

Source-specific observational comparisons and conditional theoretical cuts
regimes: Slow-roll and explicitly different inflationary regimes
Post-inflationary conversion or reheating where specified
Distinct dimensional settings retained without a universal four-dimensional assumption
assumptions: Each source retains its own action, initial conditions and approximation scheme
Conjectural quantum-gravity restrictions are optional source-specific tests

Shared notation does not establish shared normalization or physical meaning

Separate scalar, tensor, anisotropy and non-Gaussianity targets

An established common fine question for all numerical members

sources.title: Statistical anisotropy of the curvature perturbation from vector field perturbations

evidence.text: How do vector field perturbations generate statistically anisotropic primordial curvature perturbations, and what spectra, bispectra and model constraints follow?

sources.title: Non-Abelian Gauge Field Inflation

evidence.text: Does non-Abelian gauge-flation support sufficiently long, robust slow-roll evolution, and what scalar, vector and tensor perturbations and historical cosmological constraints follow for its two-parameter model?

sources.title: Non-Gaussianities and chiral gravitational waves in natural steep inflation

evidence.text: What scalar non-Gaussianity and tensor spectra arise when gauge-field production supplies the friction needed for inflation on a steep axion potential? Can low-energy inflation produce observable chiral tensors?

sources.title: Modular Inflation at Higher Level $N$

evidence.text: How do curved scalar target spaces enter inflationary background and perturbation calculations?

sources.title: Swampland conjecture in $f(R)$ gravity by the Noether Symmetry Approach

evidence.text: Can a single curvature function describe inflation and current acceleration? The improved model combines linear curvature, a bounded low-curvature correction, and a quadratic high-curvature scalaron term.

sources.title: Cosmological Perturbations via Quantum Corrections in M-Theory

evidence.text: What tensor and scalar perturbation spectra follow from an inflation-like M-theory background supported by leading quartic-Weyl corrections, and under what initial-spectrum assumptions are their tilts nearly scale invariant?

sources.title: Recent Advances in Inflation

evidence.text: How can scalar-field and modified-gravity frameworks generate observationally viable inflation, and how do their scalar/tensor perturbations distinguish them, especially through blue tensor spectra and modified gravitational-wave propagation?

sources.title: Inflation in Myrzakulov F(R,T) gravity: A comparative study in metric, symmetric teleparallel, and Weitzenböck formalisms

evidence.text: How do curvature, torsion and nonmetricity formulations modify scalar-field inflation, and can hybrid Myrzakulov F(R,T) models support observationally viable cold or warm inflation with a geometric exit?

sources.title: A General analytic formula for the spectral index of the density perturbations produced during inflation

evidence.text: What analytic expressions determine the curvature-perturbation spectrum and spectral index when inflation has several real dynamical scalar degrees of freedom, including a curved scalar-field space, rather than the single degree assumed in the standard calculation?

sources.title: Perturbations in k-inflation

evidence.text: How do linear quantum cosmological perturbations generalize to a scalar Lagrangian p(X,ϕ), and what scalar and tensor spectra distinguish slow-roll or power-law k-inflation from potential-driven inflation?

sources.title: Statistical anisotropy of the curvature perturbation from vector field perturbations

evidence.text: The separate-universe gradient expansion gives ζ=δN between initially flat and final uniform-density slices. N is Taylor-expanded in scalar and vector field values; the construction initially permits anisotropic homogeneous separate universes.

sources.title: Non-Abelian Gauge Field Inflation

evidence.text: Integrate the background equations for three illustrated parameter/initial-condition sets and study phase diagrams, slow-roll entry, e-fold accumulation and the post-inflationary oscillatory regime.

sources.title: Non-Gaussianities and chiral gravitational waves in natural steep inflation

evidence.text: Gauge helicity modes are solved using Coulomb wave functions and approximated by a late-time growing solution with exponential enhancement e^(πξ).

sources.title: Modular Inflation at Higher Level $N$

evidence.text: Use the modular derivative zero to guide an initial-condition scan, integrate backgrounds, and vary μ to meet CMB comparison cuts and 50–70 e-folds.

sources.title: Swampland conjecture in $f(R)$ gravity by the Noether Symmetry Approach

evidence.text: Reduce the covariant theory to FRW minisuperspace, vary a and R, and impose the energy constraint. The paper fixes cosmic-time lapse before its classical symmetry analysis.

sources.title: Cosmological Perturbations via Quantum Corrections in M-Theory

evidence.text: For scalars, eliminate auxiliary α and χ = a(β + aγ̇) using constraint equations and solve for P = H−1ψ. Rescaling the leading scalar and tensor variables reduces both to the same Bessel-type mode equation.

sources.title: Revisiting Scalar Tensor inflation by swampland criteria and Reheating

evidence.text: Can a scalar-dependent gravitational coupling accommodate slow-roll inflation, the observed scalar/tensor spectra, and the paper's swampland cuts? The study also asks which effective reheating equations of state give positive, relatively short expansion histories.

sources.title: Can a vector field be responsible for the curvature perturbation in the Universe?

evidence.text: Can a massive vector generate the cosmological curvature perturbation through a curvaton mechanism while avoiding large-scale anisotropy, and what inflationary mass and subsequent evolution would this require?

sources.title: Statistical Anisotropy and the Vector Curvaton Paradigm

evidence.text: How can a massive vector spectator contribute to or generate the scalar curvature perturbation without excessive anisotropic stress, and which anisotropies in its spectrum and bispectrum distinguish vector-curvaton realizations?

sources.title: Hyperinflation generalised: from its attractor mechanism to its tension with the ‘swampland conditions’

evidence.text: How sensitive is nonsymmetric hyperinflation to initial position and transverse motion? The reported tests include five trajectories and transverse-to-gradient initial velocity ratios down to 10^−10.

sources.title: Inflation with violation of the null energy condition

evidence.text: Can NEC-violating inflation with increasing H support classically stable cosmological perturbations, and how would its scalar and tensor predictions differ from conventional inflation?

sources.title: Perturbations in generalized multi-field inflation

evidence.text: How do linear adiabatic and entropy perturbations propagate, couple and generate curvature perturbations in inflation with a general P(X,φI) Lagrangian and curved field space?

sources.title: Phenomenological Consequences of the Refined Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Can a curvaton generate the observed scalar tilt while the inflaton satisfies a stronger curvature condition? The paper replaces the ordinary inflaton tilt relation with a horizon-exit curvaton expression.

sources.title: Scaling attractors in multi-field inflation

evidence.text: Can frozen turning backgrounds persist after deforming the special potential that made hyperinflation a coordinate-equivalent description?

sources.title: Generating the curvature perturbation without an inflaton

evidence.text: Can the primordial large-scale curvature perturbation originate from a light field unrelated to the fields driving inflation, through its later oscillation and decay, and what conditions control its spectrum, Gaussianity and residual isocurvature?

sources.title: Inflationary Cosmology with Quantum Gravitational Effects and Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: Can different quantum-gravity modifications of scalar and tensor perturbations suppress their power ratio in single-field inflation subject to an order-one lower bound on the potential gradient?

sources.title: Brane inflation driven by noncanonical scalar field

evidence.text: Can a power-law noncanonical scalar drive slow-roll inflation in high-energy RS-II cosmology, with parameters constrained by the paper's historical perturbation data and an inflationary interval occurring after the five-dimensional Planck time?

sources.title: DBI in the sky

evidence.text: What scalar, tensor, and non-Gaussian primordial perturbations does D-cceleration inflation produce, and do their parameter constraints make this family observationally distinguishable and falsifiable?

sources.title: The scalar-torsion gravity corrections in the first-order inflationary models

evidence.text: Can a power-law scalar–torsion coupling parameterize corrections to inflationary dynamics and perturbations, allowing models with a linear tensor-to-scalar ratio versus scalar tilt to satisfy the paper's observational and exit conditions?

sources.title: Rise of cosmological complexity: Saturation of growth and chaos

evidence.text: How does circuit complexity of scalar cosmological perturbations depend on a constant background equation of state, expansion versus contraction, and horizon crossing; does its growth suggest chaos and a limiting growth rate?

sources.title: Type I Hilltop Inflation and the Refined Swampland Criteria

evidence.text: A negative inflaton mass can give a hilltop nonzero negative curvature even where its gradient vanishes. The paper tests whether this modification preserves successful scalar perturbations while improving compatibility with the refined de Sitter curvature branch.

sources.title: Refined swampland conjecture in deformed Starobinsky gravity

evidence.text: Can a deformation of curvature-driven Starobinsky inflation reproduce acceptable scalar and tensor perturbations while satisfying conjectured restrictions on the gradient and curvature of its Einstein-frame potential?

sources.title: Power spectrum of density perturbations in chain inflation

evidence.text: How do stochastic vacuum transitions determine scalar perturbations in chain inflation? The page approaches this question through inflaton mean and variance and an illustrative construction of tunneling events and bubble-wall histories inside a past light cone.

sources.title: Revisiting Scalar Tensor inflation by swampland criteria and Reheating

evidence.text: How does a field-dependent coefficient of the Ricci scalar alter homogeneous inflationary evolution? The model introduces derivative-coupling contributions to the Friedmann equations and a curvature-dependent force in the scalar equation.

sources.title: Gravitational waves from inflation with antisymmetric tensor field

evidence.text: Can inflation driven by a nonminimally coupled rank-2 antisymmetric tensor support stable backgrounds and healthy metric tensor perturbations with approximately luminal propagation, and what tensor spectrum follows?

sources.title: Trans-Planckian effect in $f (R)$ cosmology

evidence.text: How does a finite-time Danielsson α-vacuum, defined by a physical momentum cutoff Λ, modify scalar curvature spectra in slow-roll f(R) inflation, particularly Starobinsky inflation, and what observational signatures follow?

sources.title: Logarithmic corrected $f(R)$ gravitational model and swampland conjectures

evidence.text: Use curvature corrections to describe inflation and assess whether their parameters can accommodate cosmological information and the paper's proposed quantum-gravity restrictions.

sources.title: Perturbations in Chromo-Natural Inflation

evidence.text: How do linear scalar, vector and tensor perturbations evolve in Chromo-Natural Inflation, and can their predicted spectra satisfy the observational constraints considered by the paper?

sources.title: A Tip for Landscape Riders: Multi-Field Inflation Can Fulfill the Swampland Distance Conjecture

evidence.text: The setting describes inflation driven by several scalar coordinates whose kinetic terms define a curved field space. Background trajectories and distances depend on this metric, while perturbations probe both its curvature and the potential.

sources.title: Primordial perturbations from inflation with a hyperbolic field-space

evidence.text: How does hyperinflation generate observable curvature perturbations when departures from de Sitter expansion are included, and which radial potentials remain compatible with the observations used in the paper?

sources.title: Gauge-flation: Inflation From Non-Abelian Gauge Fields

evidence.text: Can a gauge-invariant non-Abelian field drive homogeneous, isotropic slow-roll inflation, and can a two-parameter realization produce perturbation spectra compatible with the cosmological data available to the authors?

sources.title: Gauss–Bonnet Inflation and the String Swampland

evidence.text: Can a scalar-dependent curvature coupling change inflationary observables enough to accommodate a steep potential and a small field excursion?
